name: Micro Credit Finance (MCF)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste micro-entrepreneurs, street vendors, rural artisans, small shop owners
description_en: Quick, highly concessional small credit to initiate or augment micro-enterprises with fast processing through local SCAs and RRBs.
description_hi: छोटे व्यवसायों, कारीगरों और फुटकर विक्रेताओं के लिए ₹1.40 लाख तक का त्वरित रियायती ऋण। 6-6.5% वार्षिक ब्याज दर।

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
target_beneficiary: SC Women Entrepreneurs, Female heads of households, Women Self Help Groups (SHGs)
description_en: Specialized high-subsidy and ultra-low interest (4% p.a.) credit scheme aimed at financial self-reliance of Scheduled Caste women.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति की महिला उद्यमियों के लिए मात्र 4% वार्षिक ब्याज पर ₹1.40 लाख तक का विशेष ऋण।

name: Term Loan Scheme (General)
target_beneficiary: SC Entrepreneurs establishing viable manufacturing, service, processing, or commercial projects
description_en: Substantial financial backing up to ₹50 Lakhs for setting up viable industrial, service, or commercial operations with up to 12 months moratorium.
description_hi: उद्योग, विनिर्माण और सेवा क्षेत्र की बड़ी परियोजनाओं के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का सावधि ऋण। 12 महीने की मोराटोरियम अवधि।

name: Educational Loan Scheme (ELS - Domestic)
target_beneficiary: SC Students admitted to professional / technical courses in recognized institutions in India
description_en: Low-interest educational assistance up to ₹20.0 Lakhs for professional degrees in India. Repayment begins 6-12 months after course completion.
description_hi: भारत में उच्च एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा (इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल, एमबीए) हेतु ₹20 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण। 4.5-5% ब्याज।

name: Educational Loan Scheme (ELS - Abroad)
target_beneficiary: SC Students securing admission in reputed foreign universities for Masters / PhD / Specialized Degrees
description_en: Subsidized international study loan up to ₹30.0 Lakhs covering tuition fees, hostel, and travel expenses for global higher education.
description_hi: विदेश में स्नातकोत्तर एवं डॉक्टरेट अध्ययन के लिए ₹30 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण।

name: Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY)
target_beneficiary: Sanitation workers, manual scavengers and their dependents seeking mechanized sanitation business
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate or Sanitation Worker ID
description_en: Dignified entrepreneurship via mechanized sanitation operations. Includes upfront capital subsidy up to ₹5.00 Lakhs and 4-5% interest rate.
description_hi: सफाई कर्मचारियों के लिए आधुनिक मशीनीकृत सफाई वाहन एवं उपकरणों हेतु ऋण व ₹5 लाख तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी।

name: Green Business Scheme (GBS)
target_beneficiary: SC Entrepreneurs investing in climate-friendly technologies, renewable energy, and clean mobility
description_en: Promoting sustainable entrepreneurship: Solar rooftops, commercial electric rickshaws, and waste recycling with attractive interest concessions.
description_hi: सौर ऊर्जा, ई-रिक्शा, अपशिष्ट पुनर्चक्रण और पर्यावरण अनुकूल व्यवसायों के लिए ₹30 लाख तक का हरित ऋण।

name: Laghu Vyavasay Yojana (LVY)
target_beneficiary: SC Entrepreneurs launching medium-small shops, repair hubs, or local processing services
description_en: Bridge scheme between micro-finance and major term loans: Up to ₹5.00 Lakhs at 6-6.5% interest for established local service units.
description_hi: छोटे मध्यम व्यवसायों और सेवा केंद्रों के लिए ₹5 लाख तक का सुगम ऋण।

name: Vocational & Skill Upskilling Loan (VSL)
target_beneficiary: SC youth seeking vocational training, ITI/polytechnic certification, skill development programmes, and short-term upskilling courses
required_documents: Admission / Enrollment Letter from Recognized Training Centre
description_en: Ultra-low interest (3-4% p.a.) skill and vocational education loan up to ₹5.0 Lakhs for ITI, polytechnic, diploma and certified skill programs. 15% course-fee subsidy up to ₹50,000 provided upfront. Repayment begins after course completion.
description_hi: आईटीआई, पॉलिटेक्निक, नर्सिंग, कम्प्यूटर एवं अन्य कौशल प्रशिक्षण के लिए ₹5 लाख तक का ऋण मात्र 3-4% वार्षिक ब्याज पर। ₹50,000 तक की कोर्स फीस सब्सिडी।

name: Swachh Sahar Sanitation Enterprise Loan (SSEL)
target_beneficiary: SC sanitation workers, manual scavengers, conservancy staff and dependents setting up community-level sanitation and waste micro-enterprises in urban & peri-urban areas
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate or Sanitation Worker / Conservancy Identity Card
Proof of Manual Scavenger Identification (if applicable)
Municipal / ULB Allotment Letter or MoU (for community toilet)
description_en: Dedicated urban-sanitation micro-enterprise loan up to ₹15.0 Lakhs at 3.5-4.5% p.a. Covers community toilet construction, garbage EV fleets, composting units and drain-cleaning services. Upfront 25% capital subsidy (max ₹2.5 Lakhs) provided on sanction.
description_hi: शहरी सफाई कर्मचारियों के लिए ₹15 लाख तक का विशेष ऋण। सामुदायिक शौचालय, ई-कचरा वाहन, कम्पोस्टिंग और नाली सफाई उद्यम हेतु। ₹2.5 लाख तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी।

name: Solar Sahay & Green Energy Scheme (SGES)
target_beneficiary: SC entrepreneurs and households investing in solar rooftop, solar pumps, biogas, wind micro-turbines, EV charging infrastructure and other renewable energy based livelihoods
required_documents: Solar / Green Tech Vendor Quotation (MNRE-empanelled preferred)
Site Ownership / Rent Agreement or Agricultural Land Proof
Electricity Connection or Grid Tie-up Approval (for solar)
description_en: Comprehensive solar and green energy loan up to ₹50.0 Lakhs at 4.5-5.5% p.a. covering solar rooftops, agri pumps, biogas plants, EV charging stations and micro wind turbines. 20% capital subsidy (max ₹5.0 Lakhs). Aligned with MNRE and PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.
description_hi: सौर ऊर्जा, बायोगैस, ई-वी चार्जिंग स्टेशन एवं हरित ऊर्जा उद्यमों के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का ऋण। 4.5-5.5% ब्याज दर। ₹5 लाख तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी। पीएम सूर्य घर योजना से संरेखित।
